This application coming on for hearing this day, the cou  following:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has informed this Court that notice has duly been served upon the prosecutrix.
This is the third repeat bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail.

His first bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court vide order dated 29.10.2021 passed in MCRC No.45233/2021 and second bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court vide order dated 04.07.2022 passed in MCRC No.29184/2022.

The applicant is in custody since 26.07.2021 in connection with Crime No.132/2021 registered at Police Station Chapiheda, District Rajgarh Biaora (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under sections 354(c), 354(d), 384, 506 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code of 1860 read with Section 7/8 and 5(N)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 67 of Information Technology Act, 2000 and Section 3/81 of Motor Vehicle Act.

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, minor prosecutrix was studying in 9th Class in Girl's' School, Chhapiheda.
At the time of incident, she went to Coaching and outside the coaching, present applicant met her but she refused to talk with him.
Despite her refusal, present applicant chased her and he forcibly took her in his Omni Car near Nalkheda Jod, present applicant forcibly kissed her and prepared video.
When she told the applicant for deleting it, he denied to do so.

On 10.06.2021, when her father Sharif Khan went to Petrol Pump, present applicant demanded Rs.4,00,000/- and threatened him that if he will not give the said amount, he will viral the aforesaid video of the prosecutrix.
Thereafter, present applicant sent the video to her uncle shafiq on mobile.
Then prosecutrix lodged an FIR at P.S. Chhapiheda against him by stating that present applicant committed rape upon her twice.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 26.07.2021.
After rejecting his earlier bail applications, prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the trial Court.
She has turned hostile before the trial Court and has not stated anything against the present applicant regarding the aforesaid offence.
Applicant is permanent resident of Rajgarh district.
Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Hence, he prays that present applicant be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-1) has categorically stated in her statement that present applicant neither abducted nor committed any rape upon her and final conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time.
In view of the statement of the prosecutrix, without commenting on the merits of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
